title: fix(plugin-grid,components,fields,plugin-detail,plugin-gantt,console): HotCRM rendering — column label, widget fallback and rating cell, reference rail, gantt year, approval drawer, public form heading (objectui#12110)
body:
Part of #12110 (items 1 to 6, and the heading half of item 7)
Clause-②: no

Draft by dispatch: the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM (session `session_01TYgwmFK1q4KJ6Qq2WRLzsD`) dispatched this run on claim comment 6108276574. The claim's branch is this branch. The seat moves this PR; the dev does not mark it ready.

**What stays open on the card:** the second half of item 7, "Hide editor hints on the public surface". It needs a decision the card does not make (see "Stopped" below), so this PR names the card with `Part of` and does not close it.

## The items

Each item has its own commit and its own pin. Each pin was run against the BASE source (`c9fc10b1ec`) first, and every defect leg failed there for the reason the card states, while its controls passed (the readings are under "Measured red on base").

**1. An authored column label wins over the field label** (A-02). `ObjectGrid` built `col.label || field.label || prettified name` and handed that to the translated field-label lookup as its FALLBACK, so a bundle translating the field replaced the override. The spec calls `ListColumnSchema.label` the "Display label override". An authored label is now the header as written; a column without one keeps the translated field label. Pin: `ObjectGrid.authoredColumnLabel-12110` (en and zh, plus the no-override control).

**2. An unregistered `widget` degrades to the `type` renderer; `rating` cells draw stars** (A-03).
- Contract check first: the spec text the card cites is `FieldSchema.widget`'s own description, "names a registered field component (resolved as `field:WIDGET`) … Degrades to the `type` renderer when unregistered", read in the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 and again on objectstack `main` (`b7cd1af9df`). `star_rating` is a free string: the spec declares no such widget, so the fix is the fallback, not a registration. There is no alias: each hint is taken or not, by one rule.
- The form renderer (`form.tsx`) now takes a widget hint (form config first, then the field metadata) only when it can render: a registered field widget (resolved exactly as `renderFieldComponent` resolves it), a built-in control (`input`, `textarea`, `checkbox`, `switch`, `select`), or one of the default arm's own native email / password inputs and the secret refusal. The last group is kept on purpose: degrading a secret-declaring hint to its field's `type` could put the value on screen as clear text, the one degrade objectui#5322 rules out. Anything else falls back to `type`. The cascade-clear effect, which reads "which control is this row", now reads the same resolution, so the two readers cannot disagree.
- `rating` cells: the standard cell table mapped `rating` to `NumberCellRenderer`. A new module-private `RatingCellRenderer` draws the star row `RatingField`'s read-only branch draws, out of the field's `max` (5 when none is declared, `Field.rating`'s own default), with the value and the scale as accessible text. It is reached through `getCellRenderer('rating')`, so the package's export surface does not grow.
- Pins: `form-unregistered-widget-type-fallback-12110` (the renderer, with probes), `objectFormUnregisteredWidget-12110` (the real door: `ObjectForm` with the fields package registered), `cellRenderers.ratingCell-12110`.
- Two existing plugin-form tests (`objectFormNumericStep-9574`, `sectionEntryOverrides-10475`) reached the old fallback through `widget: 'nothing-registers-this'` to see the producer's `step` spread onto an `input`. That route is exactly what the spec rules out. They now reach the same spread through the built-in `input` control (`widget: 'input'`), and `ObjectForm`'s comment on that route says so.

**3. The reference rail names a row by the target's `nameField`** (B-13). The same schema read that served `fields` now keeps the object's declared name field (`declaredNameField` from `@object-ui/core`), and `pickDisplayName` reads it through `recordDisplayValueAt` before the fixed ladder: the same two halves `getRecordDisplayName` reads its declared rung with.

**4. `refreshAfter: true` refreshes the reference rail** (B-14). The rail now subscribes to the data-invalidation bus (`subscribeDataChanges` + `dataChangeMatches` from `@object-ui/react`). A change to the parent record (what `RecordDetailView`'s `notifyRecordChanged` posts after a `refreshAfter: true` action), to an entry's own object, or to everything bumps a nonce the fetch signature carries. A refetch of the scope already on screen keeps its rows and counts up while it reads: no skeleton, no remount (AGENTS.md #8). The pin checks the row's DOM node survives the refresh. `RecordDetailView.tsx` is not touched: its existing post is what the rail now hears.

Pin for 3 and 4: `record-reference-rail.nameFieldRefresh-12110`. The item 4 legs read through the unchanged ladder, so they stand on their own.

**5. Gantt dates name their year** (B-20). The six faces the card lists (Start / End cells, the row date line, the bar tooltip, the summary drag chip, the bar's drag overlay) now go through one helper. It adds the year when the date's year is not the current one ("now" in the view's zone, as the today line reads it): two digits on the compact numeric faces, because the Start / End cells are narrow, and in full on the short-month tooltip. Existing pins with 2020 and 2024 fixtures now read the year. `objectGanttInputs-11168` uses 2026 fixtures, so its date legs are pinned to a 2026 clock (Date only); otherwise they would change meaning on New Year's Day. Pin: `GanttView.dateYear-12110` (clock pinned).

Round 1 (`be73faf`): `examples/schema-catalog`'s `objectql-record-source-render-identity-6939` freezes the clock in 2026 over three 2023/2024 catalog plans, so item 5 moved its text. Its `PRE_REPAIR` `visibleText` and `sha256` were re-measured through the file's own `measure()`: with the year segments removed the text equals the old reading, and `elements` / `tags` are unchanged. Against the pre-item-5 `GanttView.tsx` the new literal fails at `visibleText` on all three tiles; at `be73faf` it passes.

**6. Approval drawer: the approver and the headline** (C-18).
- Approver: a `position:NAME` approver the server left unresolved read `positi…ager`. It now reads the position's label from the console's metadata store: `useMetadata().ensureType('position')`, the `position` registry (ADR-0131 D3), the same read Setup's sharing-rule recipient picker makes since objectui#7611 / #12089. The store fetches it once per session and shares it. That is the source used; no new fetch path. The registry is asked only when a position approver is unresolved, and the prettified machine name stands in when the registry has no such item. The raw reference stays in the chip's `title`.
- Headline: `decisionAmountEntry` led with the first key whose NAME matched an amount pattern, zero or not. HotCRM's account declares `annual_revenue` as `currency` and `child_account_revenue` as a `summary` roll-up (read in hotcrm's `account.object.ts`), and the drawer led with "Child Account Revenue 0". A field the object declares as `currency` now leads (its first non-zero value, else its zero). A name match leads only with a non-zero value.
- The `summaryFaces-11677` lead-label leg used the dogfood invoice, whose `total: 0` is a `summary` roll-up, so it is exactly the zero this item keeps out of the headline. That leg now reads a billed invoice (`total: 1180`); its purpose (the lead takes the metadata label) is unchanged.
- Raw option values are not in this item: objectui#11677 already draws them through `RecordFieldFace`, which this PR does not touch, and neither `payloadSummary`.
- Pin: `ApprovalsInboxPage.approverHeadline-12110`.

**7 (heading half). The public form is headed by its object's label** (A-09). `loadPublicForm` fell back from the form's title straight to the API name. The object's label, served on the payload's `objectSchema`, now comes before it, and the API name stays the last resort. The objectui#8408 no-widening control pinned the API name in exactly this case; it moves one arm down (no object label either: API name), and the no-title leg now pins the object's label.

## Stopped: the editor hints on the public surface (item 7, second half)

Measured on this branch's base: a markdown field on the anonymous `/f/SLUG` page shows "Format: markdown" (a throwaway render test of the real `FormPage` in public mode, deleted after the reading). The hints come from `RichTextField`'s editable branch, which renders them on every host.

`RichTextField` cannot tell it is on the public form. `FormPage` knows its `mode`, but nothing passes it to a widget: the widget contract (`FieldWidgetComponentProps`) has no such member, and no context carries it. Hiding the hints only there needs a new contract member or a new export, and the card does not make that call. The options and a recommendation are in the dispatch report on the card.

## Measured red on base

One run of every pin against the base source, before any fix:
- item 1: headers `["#","Account Name","Industry"]` (en) and `["#","客户名称","行业"]` (zh), where the override "Company" belongs;
- item 2: no `rating-probe` (the text box rendered); `ObjectForm`: zero stars; the cell: zero stars;
- item 3: `CS-0001` not found (the row read its subject);
- item 4: the rail's base source written over the fixed one (fix committed first, restored from `HEAD` afterwards, blob hash checked equal to `HEAD`): both item 4 legs red (the new note never appeared after the bus post), the item 3 leg red, the two controls green;
- item 5: `3/2` where `3/2/25` belongs; the tooltip `Mar 2 → Mar 6`;
- item 6: chip text `positi…ager`; lead `child_account_revenue`;
- item 7: heading `ats_inquiry` where `Inquiry` belongs.

## Tests and gates

The branch merged `main` at `158c75d` (objectui#12140 and #12142; no file of this branch is touched by either). Head: `fd4059c`.

**After the merge, at `fd4059c`:**
- `turbo run type-check` for `plugin-grid`, `components`, `fields`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-detail` and `plugin-gantt` (green; the console's task was cut by the foreground cap behind the dependency rebuild), then `@object-ui/console` alone: 36 of 36 tasks green. Each package's `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*.test.tsx` by glob (not counted with `--listFiles`).
- The 12110 pins, `main`'s neighbours (`pagerButtonNames-12124`, `affordanceGrantMap-12082`) and the column-identity ratchet: 9 files, 82 tests passed.
- `packages/plugin-detail/` (4 shards): 255 files passed, 1 skipped file. `packages/components/` (6 shards): 375 passed, 1 skipped file. `scripts/__tests__/` (3 shards): 180 passed, 2 skipped files.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, the three `check:vi-mock-*`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:doc-json`, `check:doc-fences`: all exit 0.

**Before the merge, at `50c7747`** (packages the merge did not change under this branch's files): `packages/plugin-grid/` 202 files passed; `packages/plugin-gantt/` 99 passed, 1 skipped file; `packages/fields/` 245 passed, 1 skipped file; `packages/plugin-form/` 175 passed; `apps/console/` 181 passed.

**Lint:** objectui's package lint is `eslint .` with inline config honoured. This branch ran eslint on its 22 changed TypeScript files only: 0 errors. On changed lines the warnings are: pre-existing signatures (`any` parameters kept as they were), one pre-existing `exhaustive-deps` on the rail's fetch effect, and four new `no-explicit-any` warnings in two new test files (a probe's props, and the `as any` casts the neighbouring `ObjectForm` tests use); `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` reads 19 warnings at head and 19 at base. The config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an unchanged file; the full `eslint .` run is CI's.

**Eager closure:** NOT MEASURED as the console's eager closure (that needs two console builds). Proxy, base against head, the packages' built `dist/index.js`: `fields` +776 bytes raw, +170 gzip; `components` +218 raw, +79 gzip. The `Star` icon itself comes from `lucide-react`, outside the package dist; `RatingField` already imported it, lazily.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- `ObjectForm`'s numeric `formField.step` reaches the DOM now only through a `widget: 'input'` hint (or a host with no field widgets registered): the registered number, currency and percent widgets derive their own step, and an unregistered hint no longer reaches the old fallback. A dormant producer, not a defect. Carrier: none.
- The Gantt's shift-mode header labels each shift-day `{ month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }`, and shift mode has no year tier above it. Same family as item 5, not measured at a public door. Carrier: none.
- Two readers name an approver position: the record page's approval panel reads `sys_position` rows (`useApproverDirectory`, the spec's `APPROVER_VALUE_BINDINGS` source), and the inbox now reads the `position` registry. A registry-only position reads as its prettified name on the record page and as its label here. Not measured as a defect. Carrier: whoever next touches `approverIdentity.ts`.
- The claim's file surface was exceeded in three places, each forced by an item: `plugin-form`'s `ObjectForm.tsx` (a comment the item 2 fix made false) and two `plugin-form` tests that relied on the retired route; `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` beyond `formatIdentity` / `decisionAmountEntry` (a small `usePositionLabels` hook, and the label map threaded through `approverDisplay` / `approverChips`); `form.tsx`'s cascade-clear reader. Docs touched (pre-authorised): `plugin-grid.mdx`, `plugin-form.mdx`, `plugin-gantt.mdx`, `guide/public-forms.md`.
